class TaskC:
    BAD = 11111
    
    def contains(self, mem, index):
        if index < 0:
            return False
        return ((mem >> index) & 1) == 1

    def add(self, mem, index):
        if ((mem >> index) & 1) == 0:
            mem += (1 << index)
        return mem

    def size(self, mem):
        res = 0
        while mem > 0:
            if mem % 2 == 1:
                res += 1
            mem //= 2
        return res

    def test(self):
        assert self.contains(5, 0) == False
        assert self.contains(5, 1) == True
        assert self.contains(5, -1) == False
        assert self.contains(5, 2) == False
        assert self.contains(5, 3) == True
        assert self.add(0, 2) == 4
        assert self.add(4, 0) == 5
        assert self.add(5, 0) == 5
        assert self.size(5) == 2

    def dp(self, row, remabove, squareabove, rows, cols, mem):
        if row == rows:
            if remabove == 0:
                return 0
            return self.BAD
        key = (remabove, squareabove)
        if key in mem[row]:
            return mem[row][key]
        res = self.BAD
        possibilities = 1 << cols
        for poss in range(possibilities):
            have = 0
            for j in range(cols):
                if ((poss >> j) & 1) == 1:
                    have += 1 << j
            works = True
            for above in range(cols):
                if ((remabove >> above) & 1) == 1:
                    if ((have >> above) & 1) == 0:
                        works = False
                        break
            if works:
                remhere = 0
                for j in range(cols):
                    if (not self.contains(have, j - 1) and
                        not self.contains(have, j) and
                        not self.contains(have, j + 1) and
                        not self.contains(squareabove, j)):
                        remhere = self.add(remhere, j)
                res = min(res, self.size(have) + self.dp(row + 1, remhere, have, rows, cols, mem))
        if row not in mem:
            mem[row] = {}
        mem[row][key] = res
        return res

    def solve(self, testNumber, in_reader, out_writer):
        self.test()
        n = in_reader.readInt()
        m = in_reader.readInt()
        self.cols = min(n, m)
        self.rows = max(n, m)
        mem = {}
        for i in range(self.rows):
            mem[i] = {}
        res = self.dp(0, 0, 0, self.rows, self.cols, mem)
        out_writer.printLine(self.cols * self.rows - res)

class IntIntPair:
    def __init__(self, first, second):
        self.first = first
        self.second = second

    def __eq__(self, o):
        if isinstance(o, IntIntPair):
            return self.first == o.first and self.second == o.second
        return False

    def __hash__(self):
        return hash(self.first) * 31 + hash(self.second)

    def __str__(self):
        return f"({self.first},{self.second})"

    def compareTo(self, o):
        value = (self.first > o.first) - (self.first < o.first)
        if value != 0:
            return value
        return (self.second > o.second) - (self.second < o.second)

class InputReader:
    def __init__(self, stream):
        self.stream = stream
        self.buf = bytearray(1024)
        self.curChar = 0
        self.numChars = 0
        self.filter = None

    def read(self):
        if self.numChars == -1:
            raise Exception("InputMismatchException")
        if self.curChar >= self.numChars:
            self.curChar = 0
            self.buf = self.stream.read(1024)
            self.numChars = len(self.buf)
            if self.numChars == 0:
                return -1
        c = self.buf[self.curChar]
        self.curChar += 1
        return c

    def readInt(self):
        c = self.read()
        while self.isSpaceChar(c):
            c = self.read()
        sgn = 1
        if c == ord('-'):
            sgn = -1
            c = self.read()
        res = 0
        while True:
            if c < ord('0') or c > ord('9'):
                break
            res = res * 10 + (c - ord('0'))
            c = self.read()
        return res * sgn

    def isSpaceChar(self, c):
        if self.filter:
            return self.filter.isSpaceChar(c)
        return self.isWhitespace(c)

    @staticmethod
    def isWhitespace(c):
        return c in [ord(' '), ord('\n'), ord('\r'), ord('\t'), -1]
